record.context_brief: Hopf algebra duality and enveloping algebras
record.original_question: Is there a more elaborate duality theory relating real Hopf algebras and weakly complete Hopf algebras in which the pro-Lie group and pro-Lie algebra facts described in the paper play an essential role, and does the existence of weakly complete enveloping algebras of weakly complete Lie algebras imply that for every pro-Lie algebra L there is an associative weakly complete Hopf algebra U(L) such that L is isomorphic to a closed Lie subalgebra of the primitive elements P(U(L))?

evidence.quote: Question 6. (i) Is there a more elaborate duality theory of real Hopf algebras and weakly complete Hopf algebras in which these facts on pro-Lie group and pro-Lie algebra theory play a role? (ii) Does the existence of weakly complete enveloping algebras of weakly complete Lie algebras secure for each pro-Lie algebra L an associative weakly complete Hopf Algebra U(L) such that L is isomorphic to a closed Lie subalgebra of P(U(L))?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions.

A weakly complete topological vector space over the real field ℝ is a topological vector space that is isomorphic, both algebraically and topologically, to a product ℝ^X for some set X (equivalently, the topological dual of an abstract real vector space, equipped with the weak-* topology). The category 𝒲 of weakly complete real vector spaces is dual to the category of real vector spaces and is closed under a completed tensor product ⊗̂.

A weakly complete (real) Hopf algebra is a Hopf algebra object in (𝒲, ⊗̂); a weakly complete associative algebra and a weakly complete Lie algebra are defined analogously. A pro-Lie algebra is a topological real Lie algebra that is isomorphic to a projective limit of finite-dimensional real Lie algebras; equivalently, its underlying topological vector space is weakly complete and the bracket is continuous. For an associative weakly complete algebra A made into a Lie algebra by the commutator bracket, write A_Lie. For a weakly complete Hopf algebra H with comultiplication Δ and counit ε, the set of primitive elements is

  P(H) = { x ∈ H : Δ(x) = x ⊗̂ 1 + 1 ⊗̂ x },

which is a closed Lie subalgebra of H_Lie.

It is known that for every weakly complete real Lie algebra 𝔤 there exists a weakly complete associative algebra U(𝔤) together with a continuous Lie homomorphism η: 𝔤 → U(𝔤)_Lie having the universal property characterizing a universal enveloping algebra in the category of weakly complete associative algebras.

Question. Let L be a pro-Lie algebra, and let U(L) be its weakly complete universal enveloping algebra. Can U(L) be endowed with the structure of a weakly complete Hopf algebra in such a way that the canonical map η: L → U(L) is a topological Lie isomorphism of L onto a closed Lie subalgebra of the primitive elements P(U(L))? Equivalently, does the construction of weakly complete universal enveloping algebras yield, for every pro-Lie algebra L, a weakly complete Hopf algebra U(L) with L embedded as a closed Lie subalgebra of P(U(L))?
artifact.category_tag: Weakly complete Hopf algebras and pro-Lie algebras
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work by Hofmann and Kramer ("On Weakly Complete Universal Enveloping Algebras of pro-Lie algebras") and the follow-up "On Weakly Complete Universal Enveloping Algebras: A Poincaré–Birkhoff–Witt Theorem" (arXiv:2004.11541), together with Dahmen–Hofmann's "The Pro-Lie Group Aspect of Weakly Complete Algebras and Weakly Complete Group Hopf Algebras" (arXiv:1901.06986), develop the weakly complete enveloping Hopf algebra of a pro-Lie algebra and establish that L embeds as a closed Lie subalgebra of the primitive elements of U(L). This addresses the question affirmatively.

status_evidence.title: On Weakly Complete Universal Enveloping Algebras of pro-Lie algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Universal enveloping Hopf algebras of Lie algebras are studied in the category of weakly complete vector spaces over the real and complex field.
status_evidence.claim: Constructs weakly complete enveloping Hopf algebras for pro-Lie algebras, addressing the question.

status_evidence.title: The Pro-Lie Group Aspect of Weakly Complete Algebras and Weakly Complete Group Hopf Algebras
status_evidence.snippet: A weakly complete vector space ... underlying vector space of the Lie algebra of any pro-Lie group is weakly complete; duality R(G,R) ↔ R[G].
status_evidence.claim: Develops the duality theory between real Hopf algebras and weakly complete Hopf algebras with pro-Lie inputs.

status_evidence.title: On Weakly Complete Universal Enveloping Algebras: A Poincaré-Birkhoff-Witt Theorem
status_evidence.snippet: PBW-style theorem for weakly complete universal enveloping algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Provides further structural results confirming the embedding of L into primitives of U(L).
